title: Japanese Mochi Crumble
description: A sweet and crunchy Japanese-inspired dessert featuring mochi and a crumbly topping.
instructions: Cut the mochi into small pieces and place on a baking sheet.
Mix the crumbly, rico, and sugar in a separate bowl.
Add the n and ib to the crumbly mixture and mix until crumbly.
Spread the crumbly mixture evenly over the mochi pieces.
Drizzle the water over the crumbly mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
